text: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business to the July 4th Scarborough Community Council which asks for staff to include the improvements to the sidewalks in the McCowan Road/Eglinton Avenue East area as part of the 2019 sidewalk repair/construction schedule. The new French Catholic High School has opened this year and replaced the old sidewalks in front of their school, their new sidewalk actually touches the curb on Eglinton Avenue East. Their new sidewalks, that are approximately two metres away from the curb, are now consistent with current sidewalk regulations. The sidewalks on the north side of Eglinton Avenue, between McCowan Road and Danforth Road, now provide a safer and wider sidewalk that keeps pedestrians separated from cars and allows for trees to be planted between the sidewalk and the road along approximately 90 % of the area. Scarborough Community Council: 1. Directed staff to include the improvements to the sidewalks in the McCowan Road/Eglinton Avenue East area as part of the 2019 sidewalk repair/construction schedule.
